# CostImplodeAI.com

> Official sales and ROI platform for the Latenode AI Arbitrage Template, engineered by BotVibe AI LLC (https://botvibe.ai) to cut AI API and workflow automation spend by 45% to 70% for AI automation agencies and high-volume lead-generation operators.

## Product Summary
- Product Name: Latenode AI Arbitrage Template
- Operator: BotVibe AI LLC (https://botvibe.ai)
- Primary Outcome: 45% to 70% reduction in combined LLM API and workflow automation bills while scaling automated B2B lead generation and agency profit margins.
- Execution Platform: Latenode.com (Partner Onboarding Redirect: https://latenode.shop)
- Official Checkout: https://whop.com/botvibeai
- Pricing: $299 one-time license (full template ownership + agency client deployment rights). Optional $299/month managed maintenance plan for continuous model routing updates and node support.

## Core Mechanism
- Multi-Model LLM Arbitrage: Routes deterministic extraction, classification, deduplication, and ICP lead scoring (~75% of tokens) to economical fast models, escalating only complex outbound copy and reasoning calls (~25%) to frontier models.
- Execution-Time Billing Arbitrage: Replaces per-task (Zapier) and per-operation (Make) pricing with Latenode's 30-second CPU-execution credit architecture, full JavaScript/NPM nodes, and built-in headless browser scraping.
